active.title: Governance verbs: backlog exit, audit close, telemetry event per verb
active.description: Audit BL-5, SK-19, BG-11; grill Q5/Q6. Every governance record change has exactly one CLI verb; a file-tool write to a governance record is measured as drift by the doctor, never blocked. New verbs: `dadaia backlog exit <slug> --disposition --release|--reason` over the existing backlog_exit; `dadaia audit close <dir>` (rewrites dispositions to terminal, appends the histo record with window-end sha and per-pillar counts, deletes the dir). ADRs and memory atoms stay hand-written and doctor-validated. Every governance verb (bugs, backlog, release, audit) writes one event (session, agent, verb, record id, sha) to the existing telemetry store — no new store, no new hook — so audits measure who changed what without git log --all.
active.provenance: operator-ratified grill 2026-09-12 (SDD lifecycle audit, rulings Q1-Q17)

active.title: Bug policy: one model (fix now), ask before registering, lineage folded into resolve
active.description: Audit GV-2/C2, BG-1/2/5/8/9/13; grill Q9/Q13 and the operator's registration ruling. One bug model: a bug is fixed immediately on the live branch, resolved_release is a recorded fact; 'open bugs outrank backlog at pick', the bug-always-solved pick step and specs/AGENTS.md:47 are deleted. Registration policy: the agent proposes, the operator confirms — a bug is only a reproducible violation of a tool's documented contract; the agent's own mistake, wrong usage, environment limits, designed validation, law ambiguity and missing features are not bugs (grill/backlog instead). Without an operator present the proposal (contract violated with law/--help line, one-command reproduction, why it is not agent error) goes to the handoff as bug-proposal, never to the ledger; no new CLI flag; the audit measures registrations per session. DADAIA 7.3 and dd-bug-registration rewritten. Lineage: Phase 0 folds into `bugs resolve` (--caused-by validated as bug id or none), lineage_source and root_cause deleted; provenance machinery (core/bug_provenance.py, BugEventKind, the four *_commit/*_granularity fields, fetch-depth 0 in CI) deleted; surface enum derived from features/* at validation, unknown refused for native records; severity gets a one-line rubric.
active.provenance: operator-ratified grill 2026-09-12 (SDD lifecycle audit, rulings Q1-Q17)
